items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: Then later on, Donnell went to China with, with, with, with Jack Carter and we got Billy Page in the band. I didn't know him.

ctx.x: Yeah. And then I spent a band we struck that was Joe Oliver, myself, Paul Baldwin, Louis Russell, Bud Scott, our, our, our, Donnell Howard, Albert Nicholas, and our, Bonnie. That's right. That's right. Then later on, Donnell went to China with, with, with, with Jack Carter and we got Billy Page in the band. I didn't know him. You see. Then there's some misunderstanding, something come up later on, the door between Nick and Bonnie and Bonnie and then when Donnell come back, then Nick decided that he would go up.
Oh yes, and he went around the whole world. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
